lines.text: Virgo, they are not a draft. Stop editing them.
lines.caption: put the red pen down

lines.text: Virgo, love is not a project with a deadline.
lines.caption: no deadline on this

lines.text: Virgo, you can notice the flaw and choose not to mention it.
lines.caption: noticed and let go

lines.text: Virgo, doing their laundry is not the same as saying how you feel.
lines.caption: say it with words

lines.text: Virgo, the perfect partner you planned for does not exist. The real one does.
lines.caption: the real one exists

lines.text: Virgo, overthinking the text will not change the reply.
lines.caption: just send it

lines.text: Virgo, acts of service only count when they are wanted.
lines.caption: ask before fixing

lines.text: Virgo, a list of their flaws is not a reason to stay or go.
lines.caption: lists cannot decide

lines.text: Virgo, let someone take care of you without checking their work.
lines.caption: no grading allowed

lines.text: Virgo, the right one will not need a performance review.
lines.caption: cancel the review

lines.text: Virgo, if you are fixing them, you are not dating them.
lines.caption: date them or fix them

lines.text: Virgo, nobody falls in love with a schedule.
lines.caption: less calendar more kiss

lines.text: Virgo, criticism dressed as help still lands as criticism.
lines.caption: it still lands

lines.text: Virgo, you reread the message twelve times. It said what it said.
lines.caption: it said what it said

lines.text: Virgo, a pile of dishes never ended a good thing on its own.
lines.caption: it is just dishes

lines.text: Virgo, let the date be messy. Messy is where people actually meet.
lines.caption: messy is fine

lines.text: Virgo, being needed is not the same as being loved.
lines.caption: needed is not loved

lines.text: Virgo, you cannot plan your way out of being hurt.
lines.caption: no plan for this

lines.text: Virgo, the person who stays is not grading you.
lines.caption: no one is grading

lines.text: Virgo, stop rehearsing the breakup before the first kiss.
lines.caption: stop rehearsing

lines.text: Virgo, love that has to earn a passing grade is a test, not a home.
lines.caption: not a test

lines.text: Virgo, tell them what you need instead of hinting with chores.
lines.caption: use your words

lines.text: Virgo, they do not have to be improved to be enough.
lines.caption: already enough

lines.text: Virgo, a crooked picture frame never ended a good thing.
lines.caption: leave it crooked

lines.text: Virgo, your care is real. Say it out loud sometimes.
lines.caption: say it out loud

lines.text: Virgo, the spreadsheet of pros and cons cannot feel anything.
lines.caption: close the spreadsheet

lines.text: Virgo, they are allowed to love you in a way you would not have planned.
lines.caption: unplanned love counts

lines.text: Virgo, quietly keeping score is still keeping score.
lines.caption: stop counting

lines.text: Virgo, maybe they are not wrong. Maybe they are just different.
lines.caption: different not wrong

lines.text: Virgo, the right person will see your mess and stay for coffee.
lines.caption: stay for coffee

lines.text: Virgo, done is better than perfect, and perfect never ships.
lines.caption: just ship it

lines.text: Virgo, the plan was supposed to calm you. Now it runs you.
lines.caption: who runs who

lines.text: Virgo, rest is not a task you can do wrong.
lines.caption: rest badly

lines.text: Virgo, the voice editing you is not always right.
lines.caption: mute the editor

lines.text: Virgo, you are allowed to be a first draft.
lines.caption: first draft energy

lines.text: Virgo, the to-do list will never be empty. Live anyway.
lines.caption: live anyway

lines.text: Virgo, overthinking is just worry pretending to be work.
lines.caption: worry is not work

lines.text: Virgo, a mistake is data. It was never a verdict.
lines.caption: data not verdicts

lines.text: Virgo, planning only feels like control until life shows up.
lines.caption: life has other plans

lines.text: Virgo, you would never talk to a friend the way you talk to yourself.
lines.caption: be your own friend

lines.text: Virgo, the loop ends when good enough is allowed to be enough.
lines.caption: good enough is enough

lines.text: Virgo, a messy start beats a perfect plan that never leaves the notebook.
lines.caption: leave the notebook

lines.text: Virgo, helping everyone is a great way to avoid yourself.
lines.caption: help yourself first

lines.text: Virgo, the details matter. Not all of them, though.
lines.caption: not all details

lines.text: Virgo, your worth is not measured in tasks completed.
lines.caption: not a checklist

lines.text: Virgo, some days the most productive thing is a nap.
lines.caption: nap is productive

lines.text: Virgo, perfection is a moving target. Stop chasing it at night.
lines.caption: stop chasing at night

lines.text: Virgo, you are not behind. You are just counting differently.
lines.caption: not behind

lines.text: Virgo, budgets are good. Punishing yourself with one is not.
lines.caption: gentle budget

lines.text: Virgo, nobody else noticed the typo. Let it go.
lines.caption: nobody saw the typo

lines.text: Virgo, criticism you aim inward still leaves a mark.
lines.caption: aim it elsewhere

lines.text: Virgo, the system you built is fine. Trust it and go to sleep.
lines.caption: trust the system

lines.text: Virgo, what if the flaw is the part that makes it yours?
lines.caption: keep the flaw

lines.text: Virgo, you cannot organize your way out of a feeling.
lines.caption: feel it instead

lines.text: Virgo, being useful is not the price of being here.
lines.caption: no entry fee

lines.text: Virgo, start the thing before you finish researching the thing.
lines.caption: start the thing

lines.text: Virgo, the clean room will not fix the messy thought.
lines.caption: clean room messy head

lines.text: Virgo, practice is allowed to look ugly.
lines.caption: ugly practice counts

lines.text: Virgo, rest first. The list will still be there.
lines.caption: the list can wait

lines.text: Virgo, the world does not need you flawless. It needs you here.
lines.caption: just be here
